<x_0.0225><y_0.7367>The fenfe of tafte is feated chiefly in the tongue; the situation and figure of which are flufficiently known.<x_0.6543><y_0.7797><class_Text>

<x_0.0176><y_0.7773>On the upper surface of this organ we may observe a great number of papillae, which, on account of their difference in fize and shape, are commonly divided into three clafles.
